## New

- Search for activities to cite in your draft or open their details from the Ctrl+K command palette.
- See how many lines changed each week and open a breakdown from the Weekly Hub.

## Updates

- Select a day or repository in the Weekly Hub charts to filter the activity list.
- Write, continue, or open the selected week’s entry directly from the Weekly Hub.
- Gitorian opens maximized on first launch and remembers the window size and position afterward.

## Supported machines and installation

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (x64).

Download and run `gitorian-0.1.14-windows-x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below to install Gitorian. Existing installations can download this update in the background and restart when ready.

See the [installation details](https://github.com/XII-A/gitorian#downloads) for unsigned installer warnings and checksums.
